Every value in this file is synthetic. It exists so that each rule in
Content::SafetyScanner has something to fire on, and so that a rule which
silently stops matching fails the suite instead of passing quietly.

The engagement quoted a day rate rather than a pay rate, and the written offer
named a salary, an equity slice, a share option, an option grant, and total
remuneration.
